column1: # Capture targets: node hash <TAB> page path
# ONE PAGE PER NODE. Not one per pass, not one per day. One.
# An earlier draft of this file listed rngit's other twelve paths as a "second
# pass on another day". That is crawling with extra steps: walking every path a
# node exposes is the behaviour the maintainer objected to, and spreading it
# over days changes the interval, not the thing. The rule is discovery without
# enumeration.
# It costs less than it looks. An rngit index is already machine-generated, a
# repository list built from the repository set rather than an authored page, so
# one page per node still gets the corpus the machine-made Micron it is short
# of. If a page turns out to need a companion, ask for that page specifically
# because something referenced it, not because it exists.
# Targets come from indexes that already exist: Roogle's MeshRank leaderboard,
# and hashes the founder had to hand. Nothing here was found by probing.
